description: This file implements functions for handling hexadecimal representations of Git hash objects and object IDs, providing conversion and parsing functionalities for the Git's object ID hex strings.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex_algop(const char * hex,unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a binary hash using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex(const char * hex,unsigned char * sha1)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a git object ID using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Attempts to parse the hex string as various hash algorithms and returns the corresponding object ID.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Parses a hex string as a SHA-1 object ID.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses hex to object ID with a specified hash algorithm and indicates the end position.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Attempts to parse the hex as any supported hash algorithm.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Parses a hex string as a SHA-1 object ID and indicates the end position.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop_r(char * buffer,const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash to a hex string with a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex_r(char * buffer,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object ID to a hex string.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop(const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash to a hex string with a specified hash algorithm, with internal buffer management.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex(const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Converts a hash to a hex string using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object ID to a hex string.
